review_state: production rev 1 - M1, awaiting owner look review
purpose: Creature detail part (PROPOSED): a monkey's ear, one thick flap wider at the top with a rolled helix over the top and back, a soft notch and flat tragus at the root, a concha bowl and antihelix carved into the front, bare skin inside and fur behind, thickest behind the bowl and at the root.

textures.name: T_PartEarRound_Albedo
textures.packing: greyscale albedo detail (baked AO darkens crevices), times each material's base colour

textures.name: T_PartEarRound_ORM
textures.packing: R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

review_notes.change: Rim crease: the flap now eases into the helix with zero slope at both ends (rho 0.72 to 1) instead of a squared ramp from 0.82, a shallow scapha groove keeps the helix reading as a rolled ridge, and the roll is a cubic Hermite per meridian that leaves the front rim and meets the back rim along their own slopes (it was a semicircle that started flat, a 50 to 70 degree bend that shaded as a line inside the rim). The largest turn between neighbouring rows near the rim is now 26 degrees, like the bowl's and antihelix's own. Rim facets: the decimation keeps the three outermost roll rows within 0.13 mm and the rest of the rim within 0.26 mm of the high mesh (the interior keeps 0.3 mm); at 0.3 mm everywhere the outline was a 28-gon with sides up to 14 mm. 1070 of 1200 triangles; dimensions, pivot, sink, footprint, handles and materials unchanged.
review_notes.gate1_shape: pass: gray front, side and 3/4 (Blender) and the head-sphere front, 3/4 and side (tools/ear_round_shots.gd) show a smooth oval outline with no straight runs or lumps and no dark line inside the rim; the rolled helix, the scapha, the antihelix round the bowl, the tragus and the notch read. Before: lumpy outline, a kink at the top of the notch side, a crease line along the inside of the top rim.
review_notes.gate2_materials: pass (materials unchanged): pink pored skin on the front and the roll's front half, brown grained fur behind, split at the roll's apex, in the Blender material views and in Godot.
review_notes.gate3_lighting: pass: neutral Blender review lighting (tools/blender/render_part_review.py), the neutral Godot capture (tools/godot/capture_part.gd) and the head-sphere shots; no bloom.
review_notes.gate4_godot: pass: imported (Compatibility renderer); the monkey preset in the creature editor scene (tools/godot/part_on_body_shot.gd) at the world's gameplay distance reads as a round ear on the side of the head; close up the outline stays smooth at rest and with H1_Perk and H2_Size at 1000.

reduction.method: Blender collapse decimation within a surface tolerance; full-detail shading baked to the normal map

provenance: Authored procedurally in Blender by tools/blender/make_creature_parts.py; no external or generated meshes. Textures baked in Blender from procedural shaders.
